WITH fv AS (
  SELECT member_id, join_date, home_store_id, valid_from,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY member_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS vn
  FROM dim_member)
SELECT join_date, COUNT(*) AS rows_all, COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) AS distinct_members,
       SUM(CASE WHEN vn=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS first_versions,
       SUM(CASE WHEN home_store_id=900 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS online_rows
FROM fv WHERE join_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-09-28' AND DATE '2026-10-08'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT
 (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT member_id) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS distinct_ids_join_oct3,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS rows_join_oct3,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT join_date) > 1)) AS ids_with_changing_join_date,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND valid_from <> join_date) AS oct3_rows_valid_from_ne_join,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND is_current) AS current_rows,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT member_id FROM dim_member GROUP BY member_id, valid_from HAVING COUNT(*)>1)) AS dup_id_validfrom,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM stg_member_updates WHERE join_date = DATE '2026-10-03') AS stg_rows_oct3,
 (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dim_member m JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=m.join_date WHERE m.join_date = DATE '2026-10-03' AND d.is_trading_day) AS trading_day_flag
